records.context: Supported macOS online installations and dedicated POSIX or Windows pip environments use their existing package tool to stage and verify an updated sibling runtime before requesting Restart. Activation requires approved shutdown. Bootstrap files, launchers, unchanged packages and the previous runtime are retained. Shared and Conda environments require their own replacement adapter.
records.label: spacr.install_cleanup#2
records.source: Supported macOS online installations and dedicated POSIX or Windows pip environments use their existing package tool to stage and verify an updated sibling runtime before requesting Restart. Activation requires approved shutdown. Bootstrap files, launchers, unchanged packages and the previous runtime are retained. Shared and Conda environments require their own replacement adapter.
records.translation: Studdar netuppsetningar á macOS og sérstök pip-umhverfi á POSIX eða Windows nota núverandi pakkaverkfæri til að undirbúa og sannprófa uppfært keyrsluumhverfi í hliðstæðri möppu áður en beðið er um Endurræsa. Virkjun krefst samþykktrar lokunar. Ræsigrunnskrár, ræsiforrit, óbreyttir pakkar og fyrra keyrsluumhverfið eru varðveitt. Sameiginleg umhverfi og Conda-umhverfi þurfa eigin skiptiaðlögun.

records.context: A supported frozen macOS, Windows or Debian installation stages its verified replacement while the desktop remains open. Protected installations obtain graphical administrator authorization before requesting Restart. Activation requires approved shutdown and actual process exit; recovery data remains until the updated desktop confirms its identity and main window.
records.label: spacr.install_cleanup#3
records.source: A supported frozen macOS, Windows or Debian installation stages its verified replacement while the desktop remains open. Protected installations obtain graphical administrator authorization before requesting Restart. Activation requires approved shutdown and actual process exit; recovery data remains until the updated desktop confirms its identity and main window.
records.translation: Studd uppsetning á pökkuðu macOS-, Windows- eða Debian-forriti undirbýr sannreynda staðgengilinn meðan skjáborðsforritið er opið. Varðar uppsetningar fá stjórnandaheimild í myndrænu viðmóti áður en beðið er um Endurræsa. Virkjun krefst samþykktrar lokunar og þess að ferlinu ljúki í raun; endurheimtargögn eru varðveitt þar til uppfærða skjáborðsforritið staðfestir auðkenni sitt og aðalglugga.

records.context: Ordinary removal preserves preferences and user data. The confirmed GUI uninstall instead previews current or all detected installations and separate cleanup categories, selected by default with individual opt-outs. Protected removal uses only a validated installed helper with the required protocol; authorization, preparation and approved desktop exit precede deletion. Unrelated projects, unverified data and shared environments are preserved.
records.label: spacr.install_cleanup#4
records.source: Ordinary removal preserves preferences and user data. records.translation: Venjuleg fjarlæging varðveitir stillingar og notendagögn. Staðfest fjarlæging í GUI sýnir hins vegar forskoðun á núverandi uppsetningu eða öllum greindum uppsetningum og aðskildum hreinsunarflokkum, sem eru sjálfgefið valdir en má afvelja hvern fyrir sig. Varin fjarlæging notar aðeins sannreynt uppsett hjálparforrit með tilskildum samskiptareglum; heimild, undirbúningur og samþykkt lokun skjáborðsforritsins fara á undan eyðingu. Ótengd verkefni, ósannreynd gögn og sameiginleg umhverfi eru varðveitt.

records.translation: Athuga hvort skjáborðsforritið hafi hætt við áður en fylgst er með lokum stýrikerfisvinnslunnar.

records.translation: Sannprófa virkjaða útgáfu og bíða eftir raunverulegum aðalglugga hennar.

records.source: Refuse activation if the installed bundle or authenticated image changed.
records.translation: Hafna virkjun ef uppsetti forritspakkinn eða auðkennda diskmyndin hefur breyst.

records.source: Offer Restart only after the replacement passes its staged checks.
records.translation: Bjóða Endurræsa aðeins eftir að staðgengillinn stenst athuganir við undirbúning.

records.label: spacr.install_cleanup._run_native_uninstall.stopped#0
records.source: Check desktop cancellation before observing the authorized helper's completion.
records.translation: Athuga hvort skjáborðsforritið hafi hætt við áður en fylgst er með lokum heimilaða hjálparforritsins.

records.label: spacr.install_cleanup._run_pip_environment_update.prepared#0
records.source: Keep the running environment until the verified replacement is accepted.
records.translation: Halda umhverfinu sem er í keyrslu þar til sannreyndi staðgengillinn hefur verið samþykktur.

records.label: spacr.install_cleanup._run_windows_frozen_update._check_current#0
records.source: Recheck the pinned installer and unchanged Windows destination before activation.
records.translation: Endurskoða uppsetningarforritið með festu auðkenni og óbreyttan Windows-áfangastað fyrir virkjun.

records.label: spacr.install_cleanup._run_windows_frozen_update._launch_verified#0
records.source: Confirm the activated Windows payload and its unelevated main window.
records.translation: Staðfesta virkjað Windows-forritsinnihald og aðalglugga þess án aukinna réttinda.

records.label: spacr.install_cleanup._run_windows_pip_update.prepared#0
records.source: Request shutdown only when the private replacement is verified.
records.translation: Óska aðeins eftir lokun þegar einkastaðgengillinn hefur verið sannreyndur.

records.context: Installer-made copies and supported dedicated POSIX or Windows pip environments can use this helper. It stages replacements while the current application executes and requires authenticated shutdown approval and actual process exit before activation.
records.label: spacr.install_cleanup.start_update_helper#1
records.source: Installer-made copies and supported dedicated POSIX or Windows pip environments can use this helper. It stages replacements while the current application runs and requires authenticated shutdown approval and actual process exit before activation.
records.translation: Afrit sem uppsetningarforrit bjó til og studd sérstök pip-umhverfi á POSIX eða Windows geta notað þetta hjálparforrit. Það undirbýr staðgengla meðan núverandi forrit er í keyrslu og krefst auðkennds samþykkis fyrir lokun og þess að ferlinu ljúki í raun fyrir virkjun.

records.context: Frozen macOS, Windows and protocol-marked Debian installations use their verified native replacement adapters. Protected macOS requires an installed helper with the current native phase protocol. Windows requires a separately published, checksummed update executable. Administrator authorization and staging precede Restart; activation follows approved desktop exit. The new desktop must confirm its identity and main window before recovery files are retired. Unsupported layouts or missing capabilities leave the executing application unchanged; no ordinary-installer fallback is enabled.
records.label: spacr.install_cleanup.start_update_helper#12
records.source: Frozen macOS, Windows and protocol-marked Debian installations use their verified native replacement adapters. Protected macOS requires an installed helper with the current native phase protocol. Windows requires a separately published, checksummed update executable. Administrator authorization and staging precede Restart; activation follows approved desktop exit. The new desktop must confirm its identity and main window before recovery files are retired. Unsupported layouts or missing capabilities leave the running application unchanged; no ordinary-installer fallback is enabled.
records.translation: Pakkaðar macOS- og Windows-uppsetningar og Debian-uppsetningar með samskiptareglumerkingu nota eigin sannreynda skiptiaðlögun fyrir stýrikerfið. Varðar macOS-uppsetningar þurfa uppsett hjálparforrit með núgildandi samskiptareglum um áfanga stýrikerfisaðgerða. Windows þarf sérbirta keyrsluskrá fyrir uppfærslu með gátsummu. Stjórnandaheimild og undirbúningur koma á undan Endurræsa; virkjun fylgir samþykktri lokun skjáborðsforritsins. Nýja skjáborðsforritið verður að staðfesta auðkenni sitt og aðalglugga áður en endurheimtarskrár eru fjarlægðar. Óstutt fyrirkomulag eða skortur á nauðsynlegri virkni skilur forritið sem er í keyrslu eftir óbreytt; engin varaleið með venjulegu uppsetningarforriti er virk.

records.context: For a supported macOS online installation, use the existing bundled ``uv`` and private Python to install the requested spaCR release into a staged sibling environment. Preserve bootstrap files, the application launcher, and packages that need no update. After verified staging and approved shutdown, activate the staged environment at the existing runtime path and retain the complete previous environment for recovery. Relaunch verifies the requested version, executable, imported module and visible main window. Failed preparation leaves the executing environment unchanged.
records.label: spacr.install_cleanup.start_update_helper#2
records.source: For a supported macOS online installation, use the existing bundled ``uv`` and private Python to install the requested spaCR release into a staged sibling environment. Preserve bootstrap files, the application launcher, and packages that need no update. After verified staging and approved shutdown, activate the staged environment at the existing runtime path and retain the complete previous environment for recovery. Relaunch verifies the requested version, executable, imported module and visible main window. Failed preparation leaves the running environment unchanged.
records.translation: Fyrir studda netuppsetningu á macOS skal nota fyrirliggjandi meðfylgjandi ``uv`` og einka-Python til að setja umbeðna spaCR-útgáfu upp í undirbúnu umhverfi í hliðstæðri möppu. Varðveita skal ræsigrunnskrár, forritsræsi og pakka sem þurfa ekki uppfærslu. Eftir sannreyndan undirbúning og samþykkta lokun skal virkja undirbúna umhverfið á núverandi keyrsluslóð og varðveita allt fyrra umhverfið til endurheimtar. Við endurræsingu eru umbeðin útgáfa, keyrsluskrá, innflutt eining og sýnilegur aðalgluggi sannreynd. Misheppnaður undirbúningur skilur umhverfið sem er í keyrslu eftir óbreytt.

records.context: Runtime adapters install and verify a private replacement before publishing readiness. The GUI offers Restart and preserves its settings before approving shutdown. Relaunch verifies the actual new desktop process and its main window. Unsupported layouts refuse before starting an installer.
records.label: spacr.install_cleanup.start_update_helper#3
records.source: Runtime adapters install and verify a private replacement before publishing readiness. The GUI offers Restart and preserves its settings before approving shutdown. Relaunch verifies the actual new desktop process and its main window. Unsupported layouts refuse before starting an installer.
records.translation: Keyrsluaðlögun setur upp og sannprófar einkastaðgengil áður en hún tilkynnir að hann sé tilbúinn. GUI býður Endurræsa og varðveitir stillingar sínar áður en lokun er samþykkt. Við endurræsingu er raunverulegt ferli nýja skjáborðsforritsins og aðalgluggi þess sannreynt. Óstuddu uppsetningarfyrirkomulagi er hafnað áður en uppsetningarforrit er ræst.
